articles.title: Power being slowly restored as heavy Thanksgiving storm eases
articles.summary: Heavy rain over flooded East Coast communities began easing Friday, and power was slowly restored to hundreds of thousands of customers.

articles.title: U.S. Air Force cloud platform breached by hackers, report says
articles.summary: The alleged incident follows a series of breaches and outages that have been reported at federal agencies this month.

articles.title: Woman surprises hospital valet who supported her through cancer treatment with Bills tickets
articles.summary: Breast cancer survivor Kate Fink credits hospital valet Jon Avery with helping her fight the disease. She surprised the Buffalo Bills fan with tickets and field passes. Steve Hartman goes on the road.

articles.title: U.S. forces disable commercial ship that allegedly tried to breach Iran blockade
articles.summary: A U.S. military aircraft struck a Palau-flagged ship with precision munitions after giving multiple warnings, U.S. Central Command said.

articles.title: Documentary clip reveals new details on Princess Kate's cancer journey
articles.summary: A clip from the upcoming documentary "Heal" reveals new details about Princess Kate's cancer journey, which she has long kept private. Jericka Duncan has more.

articles.title: Pittsburgh Steelers take the field for first game since star quarterback Rodgers' release
articles.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers took the field Friday for their first game after star quarterback Aaron Rodgers was released following comments accusing coach Mike McCarthy of sleeping through meetings and more. Jason Allen has the story.

articles.title: 2 American Airlines jets clip wings on tarmac of Reagan Airport
articles.summary: There were no injuries when the wingtips of two American Airlines jets made contact Friday evening on the tarmac of Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport outside Washington, D.C.

articles.title: Lawmakers ask Trump to rescind Putin's G20 invitation over alleged intelligence-sharing with Iran
articles.summary: President Trump is facing renewed criticism over his friendship with Vladimir Putin, with a group of bipartisan lawmakers urging him to disinvite the Russian leader from next month's G20 summit in Florida. Weijia Jiang has more.

articles.title: 2 American Airlines jets clip their wings at Reagan National Airport
articles.summary: Two American Airlines jets clipped their wings at Reagan National Airport outside Washington, D.C., after colliding.

articles.title: Shoppers expected to spend nearly $13 billion this Black Friday, Adobe says
articles.summary: Shoppers are expected to spend nearly $13 billion on Black Friday alone, according to Adobe, as the holiday shopping rush kicks off. Tom Hanson has the story.

articles.title: How severe weather rocked this Thanksgiving, from power outages to flight delays
articles.summary: Americans across the country faced disruptions from severe weather this Thanksgiving, including delayed flights, flooding and power outages. Lilia Luciano reports and Bill Kelly has the forecast.

articles.title: 11/27: CBS Evening News
articles.summary: Severe weather rocks Thanksgiving; Shoppers to spend big on Black Friday.

articles.title: Iowa lead detonation results expected soon, EPA says
articles.summary: The EPA conducted sampling at more than 130 structures in Iowa, including homes, schools, daycare centers and churches.

articles.title: "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" guests for Nov. 29, 2026
articles.summary: This week's guests include Democratic Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland and Kevin Hassett, director of the White House National Economic Council.

articles.title: When pallbearers were requested for an Army veteran's funeral, hundreds came out
articles.summary: When 94-year-old Army veteran John Tabor died, the Department of Veterans Affairs couldn't find any known family. When a Georgia funeral home asked people to come to the funeral, hundreds turned out.

articles.title: OpenAI countersues Apple over allegations of stealing trade secrets
articles.summary: OpenAI alleged in a lawsuit Friday that Apple sets up departing employees to be accused of stealing trade secrets.

articles.title: 25-year sentence sought for former chef who aided 14 suicides
articles.summary: Kenneth Law pleaded guilty earlier this year to aiding 14 suicides in Canada, but he has admitted to selling his so-called suicide kits globally.

articles.title: Powerful Thanksgiving storm causes flooding, power outages
articles.summary: The storm hammered sections of the East Coast with torrential rain, high winds and flooding, knocking out power to hundreds of thousands of customers.

articles.title: U.S. opens hotline for tips about cartels, angering Mexico
articles.summary: President Claudia Sheinbaum blasted the DEA after it set up anonymous tip lines in the country, accusing American officials of interference.

articles.title: Can Trump's support for Nvidia's Jensen Huang come back to bite him?
articles.summary: Political strategists Kevin Sheridan and Chuck Rocha join CBS News with their take on the latest turns in the Nvidia scandal, including President Trump's push for Jensen Huang's return as CEO.
